data: What is the value of the lattice density when the oracle error rate of the blue line is at its minimum?

The question asks for the value of the lattice density when the oracle error rate of the blue line is at its minimum. From the caption, we know that the left subfigure shows densities versus oracle error rates of lattices generated by different pruning methods. The blue line represents the subsampling+dropout method. 

In the left subfigure, the blue line has a minimum point at approximately 400 edges per gold edge. At this point, the oracle error rate is at its lowest. The corresponding lattice density can be read off the y-axis, which is approximately 1%. Therefore, the value of the lattice density when the oracle error rate of the blue line is at its minimum is approximately 1%.
